description.value: Boston Pizza is a well-established Canadian casual dining chain and sports bar serving gourmet pizzas, pasta, wings, and more, with roots going back to Edmonton in 1964. The Fort St. John location on Alaska Road North serves as a full sit-down restaurant with dine-in and delivery options. For touring cyclists passing through this northern BC hub on the Alaska Highway corridor, it offers a reliable, high-capacity meal stop with a broad menu.

address.value: 9508 Alaska Road North, Fort St. John, V1J 6L5

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the Fort St. John location at 9508 Alaska Road North with phone (250) 787-0455, matching OSM tags exactly.
